name: xelta-photoshop-mcp

tools.name: ps_status
tools.description: Whether Photoshop is installed and running, and (when running) its version and open document count. Never launches Photoshop. Call this first.

tools.name: ps_document_info
tools.description: The active Photoshop document: name, width and height in pixels, resolution, colour mode, saved state, file path (null when never saved) and top-level layer count. Read-only.

tools.name: ps_catalog
tools.description: List the operations ps_do can run: name, effect (read/write/destructive), description and params as JSON Schema. Never contacts Photoshop.

tools.name: ps_do
tools.description: Run one Photoshop operation by name with its params. Discover operations and their params with ps_catalog first. Fails with PHOTOSHOP_NOT_RUNNING rather than launching Photoshop.

params.description: The operation's params object (see ps_catalog). Omit when it takes none.

tools.name: ps_get_skill
tools.description: Read the bundled Xelta Photoshop skills (offline). Without args: the skill index. With name: that skill's SKILL.md. With name + reference: one of its reference files. Load 'xelta-ps-editing-rules' first, before working in Photoshop; load 'xelta-ps-reel-cover' for covers, thumbnails and image fixes.

name.description: Skill name from the index, e.g. 'xelta-ps-editing-rules'.

reference.description: A reference listed for that skill, e.g. 'references/x.md' or 'x'.

tools.name: ps_preview
tools.description: See the active document as a downscaled PNG of its visible composite. The longest side is at most max_side (default 1024; never upscaled); a JSON summary {width, height, bytes, document} follows the image. Read-only: it renders from a temporary merged copy and never changes, saves or closes the document. Use it after building or fixing to check the title, safe area and fades.

max_side.description: Longest side in pixels, an integer from 64 to 2048 (default 1024).
